blocks.text: Pollution can be controlled by the following strategies:

items: Imposing strict discharge standards on industries and municipalities, to stop harmful pollutants entering water bodies.
Upgrading and expanding sewage treatment plants (STPs), installing effluent treatment plants (ETPs), and adopting modern technologies such as membrane filtration and bioreactors.
Continuous monitoring of water quality, which detects pollutants and allows timely responses to contamination.
Strict penalties for polluters and incentives for clean practices, which discourage violations and encourage industries and communities to adopt sustainable, pollution-free operations.
